reason: Read with L 305 and the 1474 print at hand, 'in mortalitatis' in the Epiphany preface became 'immortalitatis', the faint opening of the prayer on 2v became '-potens sempiterne deus', and abbreviations such as 'Inf(r)a ac(tionem)' and 'sac(ra)tissimum' were settled.
sources: Fribourg, BCU, Ms. L 305, Missale Cisterciense, about 1300 (Hauterive), ff. 138r, 138v, 144r, 144v, e-codices page images https://www.e-codices.unifr.ch/en/bcuf/L0305/138r
Missale Romanum, Mediolani 1474, ed. R. Lippe, vol. 1, HBS 17 (1899), pp. 202, 210-211, page images https://archive.org/details/missaleromanumme01cath/page/202/mode/1up
'Eine Handschrift eines mittelalterlichen Missale', Der Katholik 62 (1882), pp. 325-327, page images https://www.digitale-sammlungen.de/en/view/bsb11905259?page=331
Brenner, Geschichtliche Darstellung der Verrichtung ... der Sakramente, pp. 395-396, page images https://www.digitale-sammlungen.de/en/view/bsb10589661?page=421
A. Hoeynck, Geschichte der kirchlichen Liturgie des Bisthums Augsburg (1889), pp. 374-376, page images https://archive.org/details/geschichtederki00hoeygoog/page/n393/mode/1up

A. A. King, Liturgies of the Religious Orders (1955), p. 148; P. Tirot, Un 'ordo missae' monastique (1981), p. 82; I. Smith, Bible Missals and the Medieval Dominican Liturgy (2023), pp. 185-186: search snippets only
text:
F-l7tu (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 212). Source-assisted reading, 31 October 2026, made with Fribourg BCU L 305 (ff. 138r-138v, 144r-144v) and the Missale Romanum, Milan 1474 (ed. Lippe, pp. 202, 210-211) at hand. A research reader reread every page on the native images in close crops: all lines of 1r, 1v and 2r, and on 2v lines 1-7 in full and lines 8-10 in fragments. An independent checker reread 2v lines 1-10 on the image. No lines rest only on the image-only first reading. Not a verified transcription.
Conventions: expansions in ( ), lost or supplied text in [ ], ? doubtful, / line break, [red] rubric. Boxes are left,top,right,bottom in native pixels (7360 x 4912). Leaf 1 = canvas 0 right (1r) and canvas 1 left (1v); leaf 2 = canvas 1 right (2r) and canvas 0 left (2v); the order of the two leaves is inferred.

== 1r, canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_212_01r), right page, box 4150,1150,6100,2250 (Christmas preface and Communicantes)
[top line trimmed] / n(ost)re oculis lux tue claritatis infulsit. / ut dum uisibiliter d(eu)m cognoscimus. / p(er) hunc inuisibilium amore rapiam(ur). / Et ideo cum ang(e)lis et archang(e)lis. / cum thronis et d(omi)nacionib(us). cumq(ue) / omni milicia celestis exercitus. ymnu(m) / gl(ori)e tue canimus. sine fine dicentes. / Communicantes et diem [red] Infra act(ionem) / sacratissimum celebrantes. quo b(ea)te / marie intemerata uirginitas. huic

== 1v, canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_212_01v), left page, box 1800,1280,3750,2300 (end of Christmas Communicantes; Epiphany preface and Communicantes)
[trimmed line] / genitricis eiusdem dei. et d(omi)ni nostri / ihu xpi. Sed [written Sect] et b(ea)tor(um) ap(osto)lor(um). [red] In ep(ip)h(an)ia / [initial V with cross] eterne d(eu)s: Quia cum uni/genitus tuus in sub(stanti)a n(ost)re / mortalitatis apparuit: in noua nos / immortalitatis sue luce reparauit. Et / ideo cum ang(e)lis. [red] Inf(r)a ac(tionem) Communic/antes et diem sac(ra)tissimu(m) celebrantes. / quo unigenitus tuus in tua tecu(m) gl(ori)a / coeternus in ueritate carnis uisibilit(er)

== 2r, canvas 1, right page, box 4250,2550,6100,3500 (end of the Ordo missae)
Corpus d(omi)ni n(ost)ri ihu xpi custodiat me / in uitam et(er)nam. Am(en). Sanguis d(omi)ni / n(ost)ri ihu xpi custodiat me in uita(m) et(ernam). Am(en). / Placeat tibi s(an)c(t)a t(ri)nitas obseq(ui)u(m) seruitu/tis mee. et p(rest)a ut hec? tuu(m) sacrificium / quod oc(u)lis tue maiestatis indignus / optuli. sit tibi acceptabile. michiq(ue) et / omnib(us) p(ro) quib(us) illud optuli te miserante / sit p(ro)piciabile. Q(ui) uiuis et reg(nas). / Meritis et precib(us) istor(um) et o(mn)ium [s(an)c(t)or(um)] (guide letter m in the initial; the last word is at a tear)

== 2v, canvas 0, left page, boxes 1750,1150,3700,2000 and 1750,1900,3700,3050; lines 8-10 also on a blue-channel crop of 1750,2400,3700,3050
[trimmed: ...]ra. gl(ori)a tu[a ...] ... [red B, Benedictus] [...] / qui uenit in nomine d(omi)ni osanna in / excelsis. [red] Agnus dei qui tollis p(e)cc(at)a / mundi miserere nobis. [red] Agnus dei / qui tollis p(e)cc(at)a mundi miserere nob(is). / [red] Agnus dei qui tollis peccata mundi / dona nobis pacem. / [red O] [..]p(oten)s semp(iterne) d(eu)s q[ui? ...] [rest lost] / [..]lis? co(m)placacio[n..] ... [..] / [..]em. omn[..] ... [..]adiu[..] [very faint]
Lines 1-7 are secure. In lines 8-10 only "-p(oten)s semp(iterne) d(eu)s" and "co(m)placa-" are confirmed; the expansion "O(mni)p(oten)s" is possible but not secure. The prayer is not identified.
